info.title: Arogya Drishti Vector Surveillance Agent Skill Tools

function.name: query_gee_microclimate
function.description: Queries Google Earth Engine (MODIS LST, Sentinel-2 NDWI/NDVI with Sentinel-1 SAR fallback, and CHIRPS 14-day cumulative rainfall) to compute mosquito breeding environmental suitability E_GEE at an Indian GPS coordinate.

function.name: compute_ward_entomological_indices
function.description: Queries live Cloud Firestore field inspection logs for an official Indian Local Government Directory (lgd_code) and computes WHO/NCVBDC House Index (HI%), Container Index (CI%), and Breteau Index (BI).

lgd_code.description: Official LGD code of the ward or village (e.g. '0404400017' for Ward 17 Sector 22 Chandigarh or '0404400014' for Ward 14 Dhanas).

function.name: dispatch_fogging_van
function.description: Selects the fastest available municipal fogging van using Google Maps Routes API v2 traffic ETA, updates 1_Vans_Fleet and 4_Van_Requests in Google Sheets, and logs the dispatch in Cloud Firestore.

notes.description: Field officer dispatch notes and target container/habitat details.

function.name: trigger_emergency_ward_alert
function.description: Looks up pre-authorized Village Officer and District Nodal contacts from 3_Staff_Directory (or data.gov.in OGD), sends an HTML emergency vector alert email, and logs to 5_Alert_Logs.

severity_notes.description: Outbreak severity assessment and recommended larvicidal action.
